items.title: Tom Malone interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2023
items.q: So I wrote an arrangement of “Rocket 88” by James Cotton.

ctx.x: Yes I noticed that. I just read, I thought it was pretty hip that, the way that thing came together and Dan Akroyd, your first assignment, if this is true, said, “Write an arrangement for some horn parts for Rocket 88.”

Well here’s the story: I was the arranger for Saturday Night Live from 1975 to 1985. And spring of 1978 the music director asked me to meet with John and Danny in John’s office at 2:00 on Monday afternoon. And it was just the three of us. And they were talking about, they were developing these characters, these guys that wore sunglasses day and night, and they were n’er do well blues musicians in Chicago. So I wrote an arrangement of “Rocket 88” by James Cotton. We did it for Lorne Michaels, producer, after I…
Did you think, in the initial stages, that it was supposed to be funny? Was that the intention?
